value: Artificial intelligence(AI) is the capability ofcomputational systemsto perform tasks typically associated withhuman intelligence, such aslearning,reasoning,problem-solving,perception, anddecision-making. It is a field of research inengineering,mathematics, andcomputer sciencethat develops and studies methods andsoftwarethat enable machines to perceive their environment and uselearningandintelligenceto take actions that maximise their chances of achieving defined goals.[1]
